rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition, median-of-ratios size factors on raw (rounded Salmon) counts, apeglm shrinkage, and an explicit low-power caveat fit the 3v3 unpaired single-batch design. QC has PCA on VST and a distance heatmap but no library-size check, no explicit coloring, and only 'outlier check documented' rather than a policy; the low-count filter is unspecified and unjustified; the reference level is implied rather than set; and the |LFC|>=1 cut is applied post hoc instead of via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment correctly avoids running human sets on zebrafish symbols and states the ranking metric, universe, and a seed, but names no GO/org.Dr.eg.db or babelgene version, does not commit to one-to-one orthologs, omits a set-size window, and does not state GO's thin zebrafish coverage. The report omits the Ensembl release, the gene identifier space, and package versions.
